scope_guards: Proximity to a motorway or trunk road is not treated as access entitlement.
A route strategy or RIS3 item is not treated as a funded site-specific mitigation scheme.
National Highways early engagement is not treated as formal acceptance.
A transport assessment is not treated as an approved model or agreed mitigation package.
Local-road and strategic-road responsibilities are not conflated.
Planning permission is not treated as technical approval for works to the SRN.
A mitigation concept is not treated as funded, land-secured and delivered.
No score or promotion is written without exact access, agreed modelling, formal response, funding, approvals and delivery evidence.
